1. (original) An apparatus, comprising:
at least one computer storage that is not a transitory signal and that comprises instructions executable by at least one processor to:
generate a first screen render from a first viewpoint, the first viewpoint being of a first character, the first character being a player's character;
input the first screen render to at least one machine learning (ML) model;
receive from the ML model at least one transform of the first screen render, the transform comprising at least a second screen render from a second viewpoint, the second viewpoint being of a non-player character (NPC); and
input the second screen render to a ML-implemented agent controlling the NPC, or present on at least one display the second screen render, or both input the second screen render to a ML-implemented agent controlling the NPC and present on at least one display the second screen render.
2. (original) The apparatus of Claim 1, wherein the first and second screen renders comprise respective first and second game videos.
3. (original) The apparatus of Claim 1, wherein the ML model is trained using game images captured during a human play session.
4. (original) The apparatus of Claim 1, wherein the instructions are executable to avoid rendering multiple viewpoints simultaneously at least in part by:
rendering a single viewpoint;
using the ML model, transforming the single viewpoint to output video at viewpoints of one or more other NPCs in the area in a single inference pass.
5. (original) The apparatus of Claim 1, wherein the first screen render is sent from a cloud server to at least one display for presentation of the first screen render at a first time and actions of NPCs are delayed for at least one frame while the ML model generates the second screen render.
6. (original) The device of Claim 1, comprising the at least one processor programmed with the instructions.
7. (original) The apparatus of Claim 1, wherein the instructions are executable to:
input the second screen render to a ML-implemented agent controlling the NPC; and
execute the ML-implemented agent to control the NPC.
8. (currently amended) A method, comprising:
inputting, to at least one machine learning (ML) model, at least a player character (PC) video stream of at least one computer simulation;
receiving, from the ML model, at least one non-player character (NPC) video stream for the computer simulation;
presenting the PC video stream on at least one video display; and
inputting the NPC video stream to a ML-implemented agent controlling the NPC, wherein the method comprises avoiding rendering multiple viewpoints simultaneously at least in part by:
inputting only the PC video stream to the ML model; and
using the ML model, transforming the PC video stream to output the NPC video stream.
9. (original) The method of Claim 8, comprising presenting the PC video stream on a player display and presenting the NPC video stream on a video display other than the player display.
10. (original) The method of Claim 8, comprising inputting information related to one or more NPCs to the ML model.
11. (original) The method of Claim 10, wherein the information related to one or more NPCs comprises geometric information indicating a virtual spatial relationship between at least one NPC and at least one player character.
12. (original) The method of Claim 8, comprising training the ML model using game images captured during a human play session.
13. (currently amended) The method of Claim 8, comprising avoiding rendering multiple viewpoints simultaneously at least in part by:
rendering a single viewpoint;
using the ML model, transforming the single viewpoint to output video at viewpoints of one or more other NPCs transforming the PC video stream to output the NPC video stream in a single inference pass.
14. (original) The method of Claim 8, comprising:
sending the PC video stream from a cloud server to at least one display for presentation of the PC video stream at a first time; and
delaying actions of NPCs for at least one frame while the ML model generates the NPC video stream.
15. (currently amended) An apparatus, comprising:
at least one processor configured to:
generate, using computer simulation video techniques, a first video from a viewpoint of a first character controllable by a player;
present the first video on at least one display;
input the first video to at least one machine learning (ML) model and not input a second video from a viewpoint of a second character not controllable by a player to the ML model;
receive from the ML model at least [[a]] the second video from [[a]] the viewpoint of [[a]] the second character not controllable by a player; and
use the second video to control the second character not controllable by a player.
16. (original) The apparatus of Claim 15, wherein the processor is configured to:
present the first and second videos on respective first and second displays.
17. (original) The apparatus of Claim 15, wherein the processor is configured to:
input information related to one or more NPCs to the ML model.
18. (original) The apparatus of Claim 17, wherein the information related to one or more NPCs comprises geometric information indicating a virtual spatial relationship between at least one NPC and at least one player character.
19. (original) The apparatus of Claim 15, wherein the processor is configured to:
render the first video as a single video;
using the ML model, transform the single video plural NPC videos in a single inference pass.
20. (original) The apparatus of Claim 15, wherein the processor is configured to:
send the first video from a cloud server to at least one display for presentation of the first video at a first time; and
delay actions of NPCs for at least one frame while the ML model generates the second video.
